offensiveAbilities.name: Pierce Armor
offensiveAbilities.description: Speartooth makes a fangs Strike against a creature it has Grabbed. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked Prone; if the creature is wearing armor with hardness 10 or lower, the armor is broken. If this Strike breaks a creature's armor or damages a creature who is unarmored or wearing broken armor, the creature also takes 3d6 Bleed Damage damage. This Strike doesn't further damage armor that's already broken.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pounce
offensiveAbilities.description: Speartooth Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If Speartooth began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Speartooth deals 2d6 extra precision damage to creatures that are Off-Guard.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
